headline: Keep an inspectable record of Activity entries
intro: The Permanent record integration appends the entries shown on Home Assistant's Activity page to a local Git repository in the configuration folder. Browse days, read entries, and search the record from its administrator-only page; the record is not purged and grows over time.
highlights: Append the Activity page's logbook entries to daily JSONL files in a local Git repository
Review days, page through entries, and search across the record from the Permanent record page
Configure a Git remote and start a push manually when you want to copy the record elsewhere

flow.title: From Activity entry to searchable record
stages: Browse or search the recorded days
